capabilities: Run Claude Code and shell sessions as terminal tabs
Show usage limits, context size and token counts on a dashboard
Resume sessions from open handoff notes
Alert by banner, sound and Telegram when a session finishes or asks a question
Open and edit file paths from the terminal in a viewer window
disambiguation: Not only a dashboard: its main job is running Claude Code and shell sessions as terminal tabs.
extras: Interface and settings are German only; desktop only, macOS (Apple Silicon tested) and Windows; needs Obsidian 1.13+; the terminal library node-pty is either shipped in the ZIP or downloaded and checksum-verified from GitHub; no telemetry; not affiliated with Anthropic or Obsidian.
intentEvidence: inspired by the Agentic OS plugin from skaile.de and is an independent rebuild with its own code
motivation: The author was inspired by the Agentic OS plugin from skaile.de and rebuilt it independently with its own code.
problem: Obsidian has no terminal, so working with Claude Code means leaving the vault and losing sight of usage limits, context size and open handoffs.
